qualification: Fractions and volumes are finite4x4x4 interior quadrature estimates of selected proxy space relative to this declared numeric physical scene at the original native start pose. They are not exact overlap volumes, continuous certificates or a whole-object false-positive rate.
The ambiguity band applies to signed facet/plane residuals. Boundary probes are retained separately and never counted as verified physical FREE.
A cuboid intersecting an observed physical surface can contain substantial physical FREE volume; zero wholly-free cuboids would not imply zero free-space intrusion.

Robot initial bodies use recorded native PhysX poses, not FK, later final poses, or source-inferred robot occupancy. Cooked hull fidelity, contact/rest offsets and unmodeled scene geometry remain limitations.
GJK distances describe numeric selected cuboid convex solids versus complete physical fixture boxes; zero distance bounds do not establish positive-volume penetration.
GT references, native body poses and these classifications enter evaluation only and never alter planning geometry or execution.
